front_blocks.md: Define **tropical cyclone**.

front_blocks.md: What are tropical cyclones called in the **Caribbean Sea**?

back_blocks.md: Tropical cyclones in the Caribbean Sea and the Gulf of Mexico are called **hurricanes**.

front_blocks.md: Between which **latitudes** do tropical cyclones form?

back_blocks.md: Tropical cyclones form between **5° and 30°** north or south of the Equator.

cards.front_md: Between which **latitudes** do tropical cyclones form?
cards.back_md: Tropical cyclones form between **5° and 30°** north or south of the Equator.

front_blocks.md: Why do tropical cyclones not form **at the Equator**?

back_blocks.md: The **Coriolis effect** is too weak at the Equator to make the storm spin.

cards.front_md: Why do tropical cyclones not form **at the Equator**?
cards.back_md: The **Coriolis effect** is too weak at the Equator to make the storm spin.

front_blocks.md: Why do tropical cyclones not form at **higher latitudes**?

back_blocks.md: Tropical cyclones do not form at higher latitudes because the **water is too cold**.

cards.front_md: Why do tropical cyclones not form at **higher latitudes**?

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Tropical cyclones form when an undersea earthquake disturbs the ocean.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
Tropical cyclones form over **warm tropical oceans**, which supply the **heat energy** that drives the storm.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

cards.back_md:
**False.**

front_blocks.md: Why must warm water extend to a **depth of 60 m**?

back_blocks.md: Deep warm water lets the storm **keep gaining energy** without **mixing with cooler water** from below.

cards.front_md: Why must warm water extend to a **depth of 60 m**?

front_blocks.md: How does **warm ocean water** strengthen a tropical cyclone?

back_blocks.md: Warm water **evaporates rapidly**, adding **heat and moisture** to the rising air; more evaporation releases more **latent heat**, which makes the cyclone stronger.

cards.front_md: How does **warm ocean water** strengthen a tropical cyclone?

front_blocks.md: When in the year do **tropical cyclones** form?

back_blocks.md: Tropical cyclones form when tropical oceans are **warmest**: **June-November** in the northern hemisphere and **November-April** in the southern hemisphere.

cards.front_md: When in the year do **tropical cyclones** form?
cards.back_md: Tropical cyclones form when tropical oceans are **warmest**: **June-November** in the northern hemisphere and **November-April** in the southern hemisphere.

front_blocks.md: Which **ocean** has the most tropical storms?

back_blocks.md: The **Pacific Ocean** has the most tropical storms, followed by the Indian Ocean and then the Atlantic.

cards.front_md: Which **ocean** has the most tropical storms?
cards.back_md: The **Pacific Ocean** has the most tropical storms, followed by the Indian Ocean and then the Atlantic.

front_blocks.md: **True or False?**
Storm surges are the only cause of flooding during a tropical cyclone.

back_blocks.md: **False.**
**Torrential rain** and **overflowing rivers** also cause flooding, alongside storm surges.

cards.front_md:
**True or False?**

**False.**

front_blocks.md: Which hazards combine to make **tropical cyclones** so damaging?

back_blocks.md: Tropical cyclones combine **high winds**, **intense rainfall**, **storm surges** and **flooding**.

cards.front_md: Which hazards combine to make **tropical cyclones** so damaging?

front_blocks.md: How do **storm surges** damage farmland?

back_blocks.md: Storm surges bring **saltwater** onto farmland, which **ruins the soil** for crops.

cards.front_md: How do **storm surges** damage farmland?

front_blocks.md: How do tropical cyclones trigger **landslides**?

back_blocks.md: **Heavy rainfall saturates slopes**, which triggers landslides.

cards.front_md: How do tropical cyclones trigger **landslides**?

front_blocks.md: How do tropical cyclones contaminate **drinking water**?

back_blocks.md: **Floodwater mixes sewage** with clean water, and **saline intrusion** from storm surges pollutes wells and aquifers.

cards.front_md: How do tropical cyclones contaminate **drinking water**?

front_blocks.md: Which **financial losses** do tropical cyclones cause?

back_blocks.md: Tropical cyclones cause **repair costs** for transport, homes, utilities and businesses, plus **lost farm production** and **lost tourism** income.
